bullets.text: Fire Risk Alert for Rad Power Bikes - **CPSC** warns that certain e-bike batteries pose serious fire hazards.
Revolut's Valuation Soars - **Revolut** achieves a staggering $75 billion valuation following a new funding round.
AI Infrastructure Investment - **AWS** commits $50 billion to enhance AI capabilities for U.S. government agencies.
New AI Benchmark Launched - **HumaneBench** aims to assess whether chatbots prioritize user well-being.
OpenAI's AI Device Teased - **OpenAI** hints at a new screenless AI device designed for a calmer user experience.
